source.creator: Raphaël Nussbaumer et al.
source.evidence: Processed radar estimates; upstream filtering and interpolation

windSource.dataset: ERA5 pressure-level reanalysis, as exported by Nussbaumer et al.
windSource.processing: Upstream linear interpolation in position, time and altitude; pressure-to-height conversion uses a standard atmosphere.
windSource.dependency: Wind also informed upstream bird/insect separation. These estimates are not independent.
